post.meaning: The wise do not drown in grief for the living or the dead, because they know what lasts.
post.caption:
Krishna's words from the Bhagavad Gita, for whatever today brings 🦚

📖 Bhagavad Gita, 2.11

उस एक इंसान को भेजें जिसे आज यह सुनना चाहिए। 💛

#krishna #bhagavadgita #radhekrishna #gita #sanatandharma

reel.meaning: Even the wisest reached perfection through action. Act too, for the good of the world.
reel.caption:
जब मन उलझे, तो गीता की एक पंक्ति काफ़ी है 🦚

📖 Bhagavad Gita, 3.20

अगर यह बात सच लगी, तो अपनों के साथ Share करें। 🙏
